text:
Maya Chen: Quick proposal 1  We narrow the Optimize toolkit for the upcoming pilot to three concrete pieces: 1) adaptive batching with per-route opt-in, 2) prefix KV caching, 3) eval-triggered regression alerts. Instead of including automated quant recommendations in the runtime, we provide an "Alpha Advisor" that runs offline on sampled corpora and emits human-reviewed suggestions. This reduces blast radius. Thoughts?

Danielle Rivera: Agree on the narrower slice. Two concerns: measurable launch gates and a way to limit customer exposure if batching causes temporary traffic surge or autoscaler thrash. Can we define both acceptance metrics and a surge-control mechanism?

Ajay Patel: From runtime: batching + prefix cache is straightforward, but we need an admission/backpressure layer to avoid batch-induced bursts. Proposal: a lightweight surge-control token bucket per-worker that limits tokens contributed by batching. If burst rate > threshold, admission control lowers batch window for affected routes. Implementation sketch below.

Leo Wong: For acceptance metrics: econ delta target: median token-cost improvement >=15% per-route over a 7-day rolling window; conservative launch acceptance if >=12% on bench. Reliability: p95 user latency <= baseline +12%. Alerts: seeded regression precision >=80% and false positive rate <=10%. Early business rule: if econ improvement <9% in first 72 hours for a route -> auto-disable batching for that route.

Khari Johnson: I'll own the surge-control design. Suggested config we can tune in the canary:
```json
{"surge_control": {"token_rate_per_worker": 1000, "burst_capacity": 3000, "batch_window_ms": 25, "min_batch_size": 3}}
```
When tokens drop below threshold we shrink batch_window_ms down to 5ms to prioritize latency and prevent queueing spikes. We'll expose per-route overrides and a console indicator.

Maya Chen: Good. Also for the Alpha Advisor output format: one-line recommendation (apply / review / not recommended), bits-per-layer suggestion, confidence score, and a short diff of outputs for a handful of prompts. Advisor should never auto-apply. That keeps runtime simpler.

Danielle Rivera: Launch gates (operational): 1) bench econ & latency across 4 representative prompt sets (pass thresholds), 2) seeded regression suite for alerts, 3) surge-control enabled and tested under synthetic burst load, 4) per-route toggle in Console + one-click rollback, 5) Alpha Advisor produces advisory PDF for at least one pilot tenant.

Ajay Patel: Implementation notes: we'll add a feature flag flag_optimize_v1 and a per-tenant route flag. Admission control policy (canary defaults):
```
{"max_wait_ms": 20, "min_batch_size": 3, "surge_control_enabled": true}
```
We'll run synthetic traces emulating bursts and a canary with two tenants.

ops-bot: Canary created: optimize-pilot-surge-canary (us-west-2) 3 nodes. Monitoring dashboard url: /d/optimize/surge-canary. Alerts to #eng-oncall.

Leo Wong: Add early rollback rule: besides econ <9% in 72h, if we detect autoscaler churn (scale actions > 5 in 1 hour on the canary pool correlated with batching traffic) -> auto-disable batching cluster-wide and page owners. Document reason codes.

Khari Johnson: We'll surface a Console badge per-route: green / amber / red that indicates current surge token level, recent batch size distribution, and econ delta. This helps pilots see impact in near-real-time.

Maya Chen: Customer expectations: Sasha/Customer Success will present Alpha Advisor as "experimental, human-reviewed, not yet supported for auto-deploy". That sets correct expectations for MedScribe and NoteFlow. Danielle to own messaging.

Danielle Rivera: I'll draft the pilot acceptance checklist and a short playbook for on-call. Also coordinate legal/regulatory checks: for tenants tagged "restricted" batching should remain off by default unless they explicitly opt in with legal sign-off.

Ajay Patel: Spike plan: 1) implement admission/surge-control token bucket (this week), 2) run synthetic burst tests + seeded regressions, 3) deploy canary with per-route flags. I'll post perf numbers in thread.

Maya Chen: Timeline & owners: Ajay (infra spike, this week), Khari (surge-control UX & console badges), Danielle (acceptance checklist + comms), Leo (econ dashboards & 72h auto-rollback rule), ops-bot will run canary. Target pilot kickoff in ~10 days if canary looks good.

Khari Johnson: One more: Alpha Advisor should store PDFs + metadata in a secure bucket and a short review workflow for an SME to sign off before we send to customers. No automation to runtime. I'll spin up a tiny review UI for that.

Leo Wong: We'll also capture a small sample of before/after tokens per-request for econ calculation. Tag: optimize.surge.v1.delta. Make sure it's safe (no PII).

Maya Chen: Decision: proceed with scoped pilot: adaptive batching + prefix KV caching + eval alerts + surge-control (to protect autoscaling) + Alpha Advisor (offline, human-reviewed). Quant automation to runtime deferred. Action items and owners noted. :rocket:
